policy.scope: Finalize dispositions for the 84 previously unresolved development comparisons
policy.label_provenance: Three isolated blind contexts of the same assistant model
policy.numeric_acceptance: At least two readers independently return status rated and exactly the same numeric rating
policy.invalid_acceptance: At least two readers independently return status invalid
policy.otherwise: excluded_ambiguous, with no numeric rating and all dissent retained
policy.existing_decisions: All v1 1491 usable ratings and 255 invalid dispositions remain fixed
policy.selection_policy: Only agreement or adjudicated numeric labels enter model selection
